approach: Static recompilation of the main program with PSXRecomp and the recomp-ui launcher; the town, tower and dungeon programs run on the interpreter first and are then compiled in the background.
notes: Needs your own Baroque: Yuganda Mousou (SLPM-86328) with the English v1.02 fan patch applied, as CUE/BIN or CHD. Tested on Windows through the opening, menus, name entry and the first 3D area; deep floors, saving and the ending are not tested yet. RecompLauncher one-click setup and Recomp Achievements supported.
